limitation: These are held-out replay scheduling metrics on recorded outcomes. They do not predict counterfactual hardware outcomes, and the observed outcome difference is not a physical comparison error. Counterfactual hardware-performance claims require a later drift/outcome model.
leakage_check: Priorities were learned from the 63041 training shots only (all with arrival_time < boundary 21920.355064249998); no holdout shot was passed to priority learning.

metadata.score_formula: priority_score = 1.0 / (mean_abs_z + 1e-12); 0.0 if training data is insufficient
